title: Integrate the shared Library reading frame for review
evidence: docs/library-ui-spec.md; docs/library-ui-renewal.md; source proposals great-library-of-siso#21/#23/#24 and siso-shell#1

spec.description: A locally verified shared reading flow with exact source pins, preserving public identity and original reader content. Public publication is a separate gate.
objectives: One CRM-derived frame across Library HTML routes.
Keep registered/selected/private states truthful and source-owned.
Expose the existing Harness metadata proposal in a local preview.
acceptance_criteria: Node 20 full Library gate and strict integration diagnostic pass.
Every generated HTML route has one shared navigation and main landmark, working local anchors and source parity.
Representative desktop/mobile, keyboard, storage-denied and no-JS browser checks pass.
Public hosts and peer checkouts remain unchanged.
spec.context: Single owner on a review branch. No helpers or public-main publication.
